description: This file defines a Dart class `SavedNewsDb` which manages the local storage of news articles using the `sqflite` package. It handles database initialization, ensuring the database is created and opened, and provides methods for inserting/updating (`upsert`), deleting (`deleteByHeadline`), and retrieving (`getAll`) news articles stored in a local SQLite database. It references external models and database libraries, and defines database schema details specific to saving news articles.

classes.name: SavedNewsDb
classes.description: A class that manages local storage of news articles in an SQLite database, providing methods to initialize, insert, delete, and retrieve news data.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the database if it is not already initialized, creating the necessary table with a schema for storing news articles.

methods.name: _database
methods.description: Getter that returns the initialized database instance or throws an error if not initialized.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a news article into the database.

methods.name: deleteByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a news article from the database based on its headline.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all news articles from the database, ordered by time descending.
